schema_on_completion.primary_train_oof: 1,219-context/205-family OOF single-pick panel: contrasts {RERANK4_minus_r882, BAG_MED_minus_r882, BAG_MED_minus_RERANK4, BAG_MED_minus_BAG_SHUF, BAG_SHUF_minus_r882} with per-seed gains, median, ci95, ci_holm_m2, p, W/T/L, harm families; Elo (r882 = 1500)
schema_on_completion.secondary_dlval: same on DL-Val91 (91 contexts, 19 families), per-seed 5-cell mixtures
schema_on_completion.decision: Holm m=2 over PRIMARY and SECONDARY; gates: primary median > +0.002, primary Holm LCB > 0, primary 3/3, beats BAG_SHUF, secondary 3/3
schema_on_completion.cells: per-cell RERANK4 receipt, bag (lr, n_est), OOB admissions, invalid and changed counts
schema_on_completion.full_metrics: sha256 + S3 key of the full metrics.json
